description: This file declares the SqueezeSPMDExpander class, which is a specialized expander for the 'squeeze' operation within the TensorFlow DTensor MLIR framework. It includes method declarations for expanding the operation and computing input/output layouts.

classes.name: SqueezeSPMDExpander
classes.description: A class that provides methods to expand the 'squeeze' operation and compute its layout in the MLIR DTensor framework.

methods.name: ExpandOp
methods.description: Expands the 'squeeze' operation into a lower-level MLIR operation.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutForward
methods.description: Computes the layout for inputs based on the operation's context, for forward propagation.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutBackward
methods.description: Computes the layout for outputs based on the operation's context, for backward propagation.
